meta.description: Watches content/medium/*.md on main and creates a NEW DRAFT on Medium whenever it changes. It cannot update an existing post: Medium's Posts API only supports POST (create) - there is no PUT/PATCH - and the API itself is marked 'no longer supported'. So the flow ends at a draft you review and publish, replacing the previous one by hand.
